# Bonfire

> Bonfire is the blog of poems, thoughts and short stories by Suryansh Mishra. It is a single page: a campfire with tents around it, and each tent opens a collection.

## About the author

Suryansh Mishra is an AI engineer from Noida, India. He is the co-founder and CTO of Alethman, where he built the engine that follows how news stories form and spread, and a forward deployed engineer at InboxKit. He studies computer science at UPES with a minor in AI from IIT Ropar, contributes to Rocket.Chat, and has won three national hackathons. He also paints and writes poetry.

## What is on Bonfire

- Poems: "I'm Sorry", "Why does anything matter?"
- Thoughts: "On the Sovereignty of the Soul", "On Death and the Flame of Life"
- Stories: "The Hollow Corridor"
- About, Favorites and Inspirations
